items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: I'm sure that Petit had some kind of an influence on him.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. And, uh, but I'm sure that he never followed Tony, you know, like, uh, didn't have any appreciation of his quality until Tony went to Chicago. Uh-huh. But, uh, I'm sure that Petit had some kind of an influence on him.

Oh, yeah. Uh, yeah. Uh, yeah. You know, what, when, when Louis started first working, like, in saloons, like, Matranga and, uh, in that area. Yeah. What, what, what was he playing? What, what, what do you think, what type of music was he playing? Well, he would have been playing the standard, he would have been playing a lot of blues.
